cohort: The study included 1007 neonates who completed a newborn hearing screen and 555 toddlers (2-3 years old) whose mothers completed a survey, all with known maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection status during pregnancy.
finding: There was no significant association between intrauterine SARS-CoV-2 exposure and newborn hearing screening failure in neonates or maternal-reported concern for hearing loss in toddlers.
